correctness.rationale: The finite domain contains 4095 nonempty vertex subsets. Exact F2 boundary ranks were recomputed for every induced subcomplex; Euler characteristics matched the Betti-number alternating sums throughout. Dynamic reachability from the full complex gives 134 states with layers 1,11,36,52,31,3; terminal/path recursion gives 17 size-eight terminals, 3 size-seven terminals, and 532 maximal paths split 292+240. The three size-seven terminals match the complements of the published exceptional deletion sets.

value.rationale: B12,38 is the canonical first explicit collapsible but evasive 3-ball, and its published evasiveness proof is itself driven by vertex-deletion homology. The complete reachable acyclic-deletion DAG is therefore a natural invariant of that obstruction mechanism, not an arbitrary slice. The result exposes 17 terminal traps one layer earlier than the published obstruction and supplies a reproducible exact benchmark for branch-search methods in non-evasiveness.
